description: Node and npm from nodejs.org, for Linux images

major.description: Node's major version; its newest release is installed (24 or later: an older Node cannot use a box's proxy for fetch)

steps.name: Node from nodejs.org, checked against its checksum list
npm install --global goes to ~/.local for the box user

update.name: Node, the newest of its major version

checks: [ "$(npm config get prefix)" = "$HOME/.local" ] && echo "npm installs global packages into $HOME/.local"
